name: obj
title: Obj
description: Build an **object value** from sub-expressions — the record constructor `{ k: expr, … }`. Each field value is itself a node, so a record can mix literals and variables: `{ ok: true, n: $count, intent: $extract.intent }`. Pure: it assembles a value, performing no IO and no op dispatch. Leaves must be pure value nodes (`var`/`lit`/`jq`/`expr`/`fmt`/`obj`/ `list`); a call or control-flow leaf is rejected by the analyzer so templates stay side-effect free. This is what lets `return { … }` assemble a result from computed symbols.
